2608.25572.title: ConfAL-WM: Confidence-Guided Active Learning for Action-Conditioned World Models
2608.25572.paper_summary: Action-conditioned world models have become an important foundation for embodied prediction, planning, and synthetic data generation, but their errors under new task and scene distributions are often concentrated in localized spatiotemporal regions such as robot arms, manipulated objects, contact areas, and occluded objects. This paper presents ConfAL-WM, a confidence-guided active learning framework for post-training embodied world models. Built upon EVAC, we attach a lightweight confidence probe to UNet decoder features and predict dense confidence maps in the latent space. These maps are aggregated into task-, frame-, and patch-level scores, enabling both efficient data selection and localized training enhancement. Our pipeline first retrains the confidence probe and warms up EVAC with a small subset of target-domain data, then performs task-level prescreening to allocate sampling budgets, and finally applies selected-data retraining with optional frame or patch weighted data enhancement. Experiments on RoboTwin2.0 show that confidence-guided selection improves post-training efficiency, while dense frame and patch weighting further enhances prediction quality and embodied trajectory consistency compared with scalar reward, progress, and judge-based scoring baselines. A quick visual overview of this work is available at https://ConfAL-WM.github.io.
2608.25572.paper_summary_zh: 行動條件的世界模型已成為具身預測、規劃和合成數據生成的重要基礎，但它們在新的任務和場景分佈下的錯誤通常集中在局部的時空區域，如機器手臂、被操控物體、接觸區域和被遮擋物體。本文提出了ConfAL-WM，一個基於信心引導的主動學習框架，用於訓練後的具身世界模型。基於EVAC，我們將一個輕量級的信心探針附加到UNet解碼器特徵上，並在潛在空間中預測密集的信心圖。這些圖被聚合成任務、幀和補丁級別的分數，從而實現高效的數據選擇和局部訓練增強。我們的流程首先重新訓練信心探針，並使用一小部分目標領域數據來熱身EVAC，然後進行任務級別的預篩選以分配採樣預算，最後應用選定數據的重新訓練，並可選擇性地進行幀或補丁加權數據增強。在RoboTwin2.0上的實驗表明，信心引導的選擇提高了訓練後的效率，而密集的幀和補丁加權進一步提高了預測質量和具身軌跡的一致性，與基於標量獎勵、進展和評判的評分基準相比。這項工作的快速視覺概述可在https://ConfAL-WM.github.io查看。
